identification: Edith Holmes (1893-1973, Tasmanian), oil, blossom branches (cherry/apple blossom) in a green glazed pottery jug on a ledge against a dark blue-violet ground, image approx 42 x 36 cm, signed lower right 'Edith Holmes'. Cream/gilt distressed frame with linen mat. An exhibition postcard/label with typed text is tucked in a plastic sleeve on the mat (looks like an Art Society of Tasmania / memorial exhibition card). Her typical loose impasto flower style.
